artworks.title: I Love Bad Bitches Banner
artworks.description: This design was inspired by my sister's love as A$AP Rocky when she was a 17 year old girl. It is a felt and cotton fabric banner entirely handstitched with small beaded details, a solid border, and hanging loops on the back.

artworks.title: Very Hungry Boy Card

artworks.title: Just Like Butter Wedding Banner
artworks.description: This felt and cotton fabric banner was a wedding gift for friends who described their relationship like butter melting into mashed potatoes-a beautiful amalgamation of souls. I can include names and/or date for an additional $20.

artworks.title: Camp Banner
artworks.description: My friends had a camp themed bachelorette party and I crafted this banner to help celebrate! I thrifted that beautiful green material for the base and handstitched every felt piece and bead on top. The disco ball, stars, and beadwork are optional for an additional $20.

artworks.title: Name Banner
artworks.description: Handstitched felt name sign for your kiddo's room. You can pick colors from my felt library to completely customize the banner, or I'd love to surprise you with the final design. Ribbon adornment available for $5 and star additions are available for $10.

artworks.title: Hello Banner
artworks.description: A bright, playful welcome banner made from hand-cut felt letters and layered color. The rainbow letters are stitched and assembled with a chunky, handmade finish that feels cheerful and nostalgic—perfect for a nursery, playroom, or front entry.

artworks.title: Wished Upon a Star Nursery Banner Set
artworks.description: A dreamy night-sky nursery banner with puff clouds, a gold star, and soft pastel colors. This hand-stitched felt piece is designed to feel gentle and whimsical, bringing a cozy celestial mood to a nursery, reading nook, or baby's room.

artworks.title: Custom Commission
artworks.description: Commission a one-of-a-kind felt piece for a gift, nursery, celebration, or special memory. Tell me what you're envisioning below and choose any details you'd like included.

artworks.title: Handmade Pride Cards
artworks.description: Pride card with rippling effects. Cards can be flowers, hearts, triangles, or circles at the centers in any pride flag colors. Small text optional! $5/card or a $15/set of 4 cards

artworks.title: Block-Print Thank You Cards
artworks.description: I carved this lino block in 2025 for the thank you cards for our wedding shower! This card is available for print on handmade paper (for a more rustic feel) or cardstock. Block printing are fun to make in batches, so an individual card is $7 but you can get 6 for $20! Envelopes included.
